description: Update an existing blog post's content, metadata, status, or SEO fields. Only provided fields are changed.

content.description: New markdown body (GFM + inline raw HTML). Supports ![alt](url), <video>, <iframe> embeds, <details>/<summary>, <mark>, <kbd>.

coverImageUrl.description: New URL for the cover image

excerpt.description: New short summary or preview text

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the blog post to update

seoDescription.description: New meta description for search engines

status.description: New publication status for the post

tags.description: Replace the post's tags with this list of tag names (created if missing). Empty array clears all tags; omit to leave tags unchanged.

title.description: New title for the blog post

name: neuron_update_blog_post
title: Update Blog Post
